name: Core Orchestration
description: Main scanner orchestration and risk-scoring logic. Includes the primary orchestrator class that coordinates all scanners, the decision tree that classifies verdicts (SILENT/WHINE/BARK), and the flat src/ CLI entry point which duplicates this orchestration for the primary npm module.

name: Scanners
description: Individual security scanners covering CVE/OSV lookup, static code pattern analysis, package reputation across registries, threat intelligence aggregation, and VirusTotal malware detection. Includes both the structured src/scanners/ copies and their flat src/ counterparts used by the primary CLI module.

name: Alerts
description: Notification layer responsible for delivering Telegram bot alerts when packages reach BARK-level danger. Includes both the structured src/alerts/ version and its flat src/ counterpart.

name: CLI and Automation
description: CLI entry points, cron jobs, git hooks, npm hooks, and operational scripts. Covers nightly dependency scanning, log archival, pre-commit enforcement, postinstall scanning, threat intel scheduling, tunnel health monitoring, and the legacy installer.

name: Infrastructure and Utilities
description: Low-level support modules: path resolution and directory initialization for the guard-dog home directory, the interactive setup wizard managing config persistence and hook installation, and the ESM dynamic module loader utility.

name: Configuration
description: Runtime and packaging configuration. Includes the main runtime config (thresholds, API settings, verdict cutoffs), the trusted-providers allowlist, npm package manifest, publish ignore rules, secrets template, and the batch scan example payload.

name: Documentation
description: All project documentation: public README, project context, operations manifest, directory index, security disclosure policy, Claude Code skill definition for the /guardog slash command, agent instructions (CLAUDE.md), and the nightly digest report template.

name: Tests
description: Unit and integration test suite covering CVE checking, reputation signals, pattern detection, decision tree evaluation, Telegram message formatting, and scan history persistence.
